burn_in.purpose: Operational reliability validation only; it does not gate the official 90-day clock.

challenge.success_metric: Verified net cash actually received by the deadline, after fees, refunds, and authorized expenses.

strategy.current_daily_priority: Earn qualified visits through implementation guides, evidence-led teardowns, and agency outreach.
strategy.offer: Free readiness scan leading to a paid implementation audit

active_experiments.name: Evidence-first landing page
active_experiments.hypothesis: A concrete scorecard and sample findings will produce more scanner starts than generic AI-commerce claims.
active_experiments.evaluation_rule: Evaluate after 200 qualified landing-page visits; do not infer a result before minimum exposure.
